Stream estimates

stream_estimate.Rd

Estimates recorded alongside the stream log, retained for later comparison with analytical estimates. Values are taken from the source sheet; they are not recalculated by this package.

Usage

stream_estimate

Format

A data frame with 162 rows and 7 variables:

date

Stream date, matched to `stream_obs` using source row order.

estimate_just_today

Source estimate labeled “Estimate Just Today”; its units are inferred.

average_blocks_per_hour

Source values under “Estimate Average”; they appear to be a running average of blocks per hour. This interpretation is inferred.

estimated_hours_at_average_rate

Source column T has no header. Values appear to estimate hours remaining using the average rate; this interpretation and unit are inferred pending Jamie's confirmation.

streams_left

Source estimate of streams remaining.

weeks, months

Source estimates of time remaining.

Estimates are available from 2017-01-03 to 2017-08-10 under the provisional year assumption. Keep the inferred meanings of the average-rate columns clearly distinguished from the source headings until confirmed.

Source

Doug's Nether Perimeter source spreadsheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1jrO-xAbp_sMstrJlWC6fsNnBINRrmrwquY-oOr8zW5o/edit?gid=44479275
